पिनस m. (-सः) Cold, catarrh: see पीनस.

पीनस m. (-सः)
 1. Cough, catarrh.
 2. Cold, affecting the nose, in-
flammation of the schneiderian membrane.
 E. पीन fat, षो to
destroy, aff. क.

पिनह्य ind. Having put on or dressed.
 E. अपि before, नह् to tie, ल्यप् aff.

पिनाक mn. (-कः-कं)
 1. The bow of Ś

. A trident or three-pronged
spear.
 3. The trident of Ś

. A shower of dust.
 f. (-की) A
musical instrument, a sort of viol.
 E. पा to preserve, (the world,)
Unādi aff. आकन्, the radical vowel changed to इ, and नुम्
augment.

पिनाकिन् m. (-की) ŚIVA.
 E. पिनाक ŚIVA'S bow or trident, and
इनि aff.

पिन्यास n. (-सं) Asafœtida.
 E. अपि before, न्यस् (compounded of नि and
अस् to throw,) to be given or placed in condiments, aff. घञ्.

पीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fat, bulky, corpulent, large, much, round,
thick.
 E. प्यै to grow or enlarge, aff. क्त, form irr.

पीनसिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Having a cold.
 E. पीनस, and इनि aff.

पीनोध्नी f. (-ध्नी) A cow with full or large udders.
 E. पीन large, सधस् an
udder, ङीप् aff. and अनङ् augment.
